guards: Existing pure ditto path unchanged. New paired path requires >=3 stable same-x ditto marks in the right leading column, matching >=3 marks in the same left column, sizes within 20%, same y, gap below 32em. All actual values must precede marks; at most two prefix words per column. Wrapped headers/values remain under existing logic.

band_cut suppresses an adjacent row cut only when >=2 stable simple repeated columns align, and one has an initial value >=12em wide immediately before the run (gap <=0.5em). Short ordinary cells and wrapped starts do not qualify. This wide initial value is what creates the long gutter and makes short prefixes falsely look like independent columns.
